content:
ana: Quick sync — we need a concrete proposal for the rerank endpoint before next planning. primary asks: top_k semantics, score normalization, truncation behavior, and launch checklist.

sam: Agreed. Customers keep asking why our reranker scores aren't comparable across models. want a way to normalize and optionally expose raw scores.

jordan: From infra side: keep MVP simple to avoid perf regressions. normalization options can be a flag; default should be the perf-friendly path.

ana: @sam can you sketch expected inputs? is it a list of (candidate, metadata) or just ids + text?

sam: MVP input: array of candidates with id + text + optional precomputed_embedding. proto:
```json
{
  "query": "how to reset password",
  "candidates": [
    {"id":"c1","text":"resetting your password"},
    {"id":"c2","text":"forgot password flow","embedding": [0.001, -0.23, ...]}
  ],
  "top_k": 5,
  "normalize_scores": true,
  "truncate_candidates": "none" // options: none | longest_only | cutoff_tokens
}
```

lee: devex note: SDKs should accept both text-only and id+meta forms. also add a helper that warns when candidates > 1k.

jordan: On top_k: semantics we propose: "return up to top_k candidates" (not guarantee exactly top_k if some are filtered), stable sort by score desc, ties break by candidate id. don't auto-pad.

sam: Scoring normalization proposals (short):
- none: return model raw score (logit / similarity).
- min-max per-request: scale scores to [0,1] using min/max of returned set.
- z-score: (score-mean)/std, for debugging only.
- model-calibrated: use precomputed calibration map per model to map raw -> calibrated probability.
Default: min-max (user-friendly) with opt-out via `normalize_scores=false`.

ana: truncation rules? customers worry about candidate snippets being cut mid-token and breaking relevance.

sam: Options:
- truncate_candidates: none (send full), longest_only (truncate only candidates > N tokens), cutoff_tokens (hard token cap per candidate).
- If truncation occurs, return a `truncated:true` flag per candidate and `original_length_tokens` in metadata.

jordan: Performance constraints: keep latency SLO for 95th <= hosted baseline + 30ms for batches of 16 candidates. normalization path should be O(n) with small constant; avoid cross-model expensive ops at request time unless opted-in.

ana: Launch criteria (MVP):
- spec + open API contract in docs
- SDK acceptance tests (py/ts) for input shapes
- perf test across 3 model families (llama-variant, instruction-tuned, similarity models)
- >=90% accuracy on regression eval (existing rerank prompts)
- telemetry for truncation, normalization usage, average candidates per request

lee: Stretch ideas for post-launch:
- server-side calibration storage for each model and auto-apply,
- `top_k` backed by approximate nearest neighbor pre-filter for large candidate pools,
- per-customer default policies (e.g., auto normalize for enterprise).

ana: Prioritization: MVP must include `top_k`, stable sort, per-request `normalize_scores` flag, and basic truncation with per-candidate `truncated` flag. model-calibrated mapping is stretch.

sam: Implementation notes for eng-ml: compute raw scores, then if normalize==min-max do min/max on returned set. if model-calibrated requested, run calibration map (O(n)). expose both `score` and `normalized_score` in response.

jordan: Response proto example:
```json
{
  "results": [
    {"id":"c2","score":-1.23,"normalized_score":0.95,"truncated":false},
    {"id":"c1","score":-2.1,"normalized_score":0.48,"truncated":true, "orig_tokens": 134}
  ],
  "stats": {"candidates_evaluated": 12, "top_k_requested": 5}
}
```

ops-bot: created doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/rerank-api-draft (ops note: ensure ACLs) :white_check_mark:

ana: Next steps: sam + jordan create a short PR with the API contract + perf estimate by EOD Fri. i'll slot feature in roadmap for next sprint and prepare customer comms.

lee: I'll draft SDK helpers and add warning telemetry when normalize_scores:false but models differ by family.

sam: ack, will add unit tests for edge-cases (all-equal scores, negative-only scores, >1k candidates).

ana: Thanks all — keeping scope lean helps us ship. :rocket:
